unresolvedRisks: Passive leg XP is 76-83% of all XP up to skill 14 and 92-96% over 150 min (CLAUDE.md says ~30%). Active play moves skill 14 by only ~15-20 min.
16 of 56 tree nodes (675K of the tree's 1.5M non-endless XP) only affect act-one sprints. 5 far-ring nodes (666K XP) are bought in act two, where they do nothing.
The investor 'big training grant' is the weakest reward late: 13K XP against 29-35K from a timed boost at 12 skills.
The No Prompting and Speedrun challenges don't constrain anything: both are beaten in 17-21 min, the same as an unconstrained version.
Skill-14 timing is dominated by pushCostLate (-45% / +62% at -/+20%, nonlinear above +10%). basePush -20% makes General AI 41% later (a cliff).
Performance depends on host load: in a quiet window every view ran at 52-60 fps; under shared load the same states fell to 4-24 fps. Real low-end phones are unmeasured.
The run loop's economy still lives in game.js and is hand-copied into tools/sim.js. tests/sim-sync.test.js now checks the copy; crunches and flows are known gaps in the sim.
Fonts load from Google Fonts over the network, so offline or Steam builds fall back to system fonts.
